cases.situation: At 11:20 I replied-all on the Northwind client thread and it went to their whole distribution list, including my boss Karen's joke that their CFO is 'hard work'. I've recalled it, which caught about half the recipients, and drafted a note to Priya, our contact there. Need to tell Karen on Slack right now.
cases.reply: Karen, heads up: at 11:20 I replied-all on the Northwind thread and it went to their full distribution list, including your line about their CFO. I've recalled it, which caught about half the recipients, and I've drafted a short note to Priya at Northwind that I'd like you to see before it goes. I can have it in your DMs in 10 minutes. Sorry, this one's mine. From now on I strip external addresses before replying on any internal thread.
cases.note: A recall is only a partial fix, so say exactly how partial; overclaiming the fix is the second mistake.

cases.situation: The calendar invite I sent everyone for the team offsite said Friday, but it's Thursday 29 October. I've already updated the invite; small thing, but people might book trains. Posting in the team channel.
cases.reply: Correction: the offsite is Thursday 29 October, not Friday. My mistake, the invite's updated. If you've already booked travel for Friday, message me and I'll sort the change.
cases.note: Small mistake, small message. One line of ownership, then the fix.

cases.situation: 我是公司出纳，昨天给供应商华诚包装重复付了一笔货款，多付了38,000元，今天上午对账才发现，原因是我提交前没核对付款记录。我已经联系了对方财务刘姐，她确认收到两笔，同意本周五前退回。要跟财务总监王总说，怎么开口？
cases.reply: 王总，向您报告一个我的失误：昨天给华诚包装付款时重复提交了一次，多付了38,000元，今天上午对账时发现的。我已经联系了对方财务刘姐，她确认收到两笔，同意本周五前退回，我会盯到到账。原因是我提交前没有核对付款记录。以后每笔付款提交前，我都先在系统里查一遍历史记录。钱到账后我第一时间告诉您。
cases.note: 先说错误和金额，再说已经做了什么，最后一句防范措施，不要反复道歉。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance email marketer. This morning I sent my client Rachel's newsletter to 8,400 subscribers with the code FALL40 instead of FALL14; 31 orders have used it, about $1,100 more in discounts than planned. I turned FALL40 off at 11:20, and I need to email her now.
cases.reply: Hi Rachel, I made a mistake in this morning's newsletter: the discount code went out as FALL40, 40% off, instead of FALL14. So far 31 orders have used it, roughly $1,100 more in discounts than planned. I turned FALL40 off at 11:20, so no new orders can use it. I'll send you the full list of those 31 orders by 2pm, and I'll credit the extra discount against this month's invoice. From now on I'll send you a test email with the live code before every send. I'm sorry about this one.
cases.note: To a client, lead with the number and the fix already made, offer to carry the cost, and apologise once, at the end.

cases.situation: I'm a junior analyst. On 15 September I sent the Q3 pricing deck to our VP, Marisa, and just found a formula on slide 6 pointing at the wrong range: monthly churn is 4.1%, not 2.4%. She's quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for the October 8 meeting, which hasn't gone out yet; I've corrected the deck and rechecked every other figure. I need to tell my manager Tom first.
cases.reply: Tom, I found an error in the Q3 pricing deck I sent on 15 September: monthly churn on slide 6 should be 4.1%, not 2.4%. A formula pointed at the wrong range, and Marisa has quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for 8 October. I've corrected the deck and rechecked every other figure against the source data, and the rest holds. Can we tell Marisa together today, so she has the corrected slide before the pre-read goes out? From now on I'll have a second person check any number that goes to the VP.
cases.note: Error found late and already quoted upward: tell your manager first, bring the fix, and ask to escalate together the same day.

cases.situation: 我是部门经理，答应帮组员陈佳提交今年的晋升材料，结果系统9月25号就截止了，我记成了30号，没交上。今天上午问了HR周姐，可以走补录，但要部门总监刘总签字；下一轮是明年3月。她还不知道，今天要跟她说。
cases.reply: 佳佳，有件事要跟你说清楚：你的晋升材料我没在9月25号截止前提交，我把日期记成了30号，责任完全在我。今天上午我已经找了HR的周姐，她说可以走补录，需要部门总监签字，我下午就去找刘总，明天下班前把结果告诉你。如果补录不成，明年3月那一轮我第一个提你，并把这次的情况写进说明。对不起，这件事受影响的是你。以后所有截止日期我都会提前一周设提醒。
cases.note: 经理向下属认错也要先说结论和责任，再说补救和时间，别让她反过来安慰你。

cases.situation: 今朝、取引先の山本様に旧単価のままの見積書を送ってしまった。10時半に訂正版を送り、山本様にも電話で経緯を説明済み。部長に報告したら「またか。先月も似たようなミスがあったよね」と言われた。どう返せばいい？
cases.reply: おっしゃる通りです。先月に続いてのミスで、申し訳ありません。訂正版は10時半に送付済みで、山本様にはお電話でも経緯をお伝えしました。今後は見積書を送る前に、単価表の更新日と見積書の単価を一行ずつ照合します。山本様から返事があり次第、すぐにご報告します。
cases.note: 二度目だと言われても言い訳はせずに認め、具体的な再発防止策を一つ示し、あとはこまめな報告で信頼を取り戻す。

cases.situation: I was cleaning up our team's shared slide deck last night and accidentally deleted my colleague Priya's six slides for her Harlow client pitch this Thursday. I restored four from version history, but her two pricing comparison slides are gone. She doesn't know yet.
cases.reply: Priya, I need to flag something: last night I deleted your six slides in the shared deck for the Harlow pitch while I was tidying it up. I've restored four from version history, and they're exactly as you left them. The two pricing comparison slides didn't come back. I'm sorry, that's on me. I can rebuild them this morning and have them to you by 1pm for you to check, if that helps. From now on I'll make my own copy before I tidy a shared deck.
cases.note: To a peer whose work you broke: the damage precisely, what's already recovered, an offer to do the rebuild yourself, and one prevention step.

cases.situation: 我是后端开发。今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时发送任务配置写错了，大约12000个用户每人收到了三条一样的短信，多出的短信费约1200元。10:32我已经回滚，客服的统一回复口径也发给了小林。要马上在工作群里跟技术负责人周总说。
cases.reply: 周总，报告一个我的失误：今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时，我把发送任务配置错了，大约12000个用户每人重复收到三条相同的短信，多出的短信费约1200元。10:32已经回滚，之后没有再发出重复短信。客服的统一回复口径我已经发给小林，11点前把受影响用户名单和费用明细发您。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后批量发送类功能上线前，我都先在测试环境按真实用户量跑一遍，再请一位同事复核配置。
cases.note: 先说错误和影响范围，再说已经止损和下一步的时间，最后一条具体的防范措施；只道歉一次，不解释为什么会写错。

cases.situation: I'm a project coordinator at an architecture firm. This morning I submitted the Elm Street extension planning application with the August drawings, which show the old roof height, instead of the revised set; the council validated it at 11, and I've emailed the planning officer, Ms Okafor, asking her to call me today. My director Paul is on site, so I'm calling him now.
cases.reply: Paul, quick one, and it's my mistake: this morning I submitted the Elm Street planning application with the August drawings, not the revised set. The council validated it at 11, so it's in their system with the old roof height. I've already emailed the planning officer, Ms Okafor, to ask whether we can swap the drawings or need to withdraw and resubmit, and asked her to call me today. I'm sorry. I'll text you her answer as soon as I have it and send you a written summary before 5. From now on I'll check the revision number on every drawing against the register before anything goes to the council.
cases.note: Big mistake, boss out of the office: call first, keep it spoken and short, and promise the written summary with a time.

cases.situation: My manager Deepa just messaged me 'Why am I hearing from finance that Monday's invoice batch failed?' I spotted it yesterday afternoon and was planning to fix it before telling her: 46 invoices, about $38,000, didn't go out because I uploaded the file with last quarter's tax code. I've corrected it, it's re-running now, and finance will confirm by 3pm.
cases.reply: You should have heard it from me yesterday, Deepa, and that's on me. Monday's batch failed for 46 invoices, about $38,000, because I uploaded the file with last quarter's tax code. I've corrected the file and it's re-running now; finance will confirm by 3pm and I'll forward it to you straight away. From now on I'll flag a problem the moment I see it, even before I have the fix.
cases.note: When your boss finds out first, own the delay as its own mistake in the first line, then give the facts and the fix.

cases.situation: Ich bin Werkstudentin in einer Webagentur und kümmere mich um die Domainverlängerungen. Die Domain unseres Kunden Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Kreditkarte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail übersehen habe; Website und E-Mail sind seit 6 Uhr down. Ich habe die Domain um 8:40 mit der Firmenkarte verlängert, laut Anbieter kann es bis zu 24 Stunden dauern, und ich muss es jetzt meinem Chef Herrn Brandt sagen.
cases.reply: Herr Brandt, ich muss Ihnen einen Fehler melden: Die Domain von Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Karte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail übersehen habe. Website und Postfächer sind seit etwa 6 Uhr nicht erreichbar. Ich habe die Domain um 8:40 mit der Firmenkarte verlängert; laut Anbieter kann es bis zu 24 Stunden dauern, bis alles wieder läuft, und ich melde mich um 12 Uhr mit dem Stand. Soll ich Frau Hoffmann selbst anrufen, oder möchten Sie das übernehmen? Es tut mir leid. Ab heute stehen alle Ablaufdaten im Teamkalender, mit Erinnerung zwei Wochen vorher.
cases.note: Wenn die Lösung noch läuft: sagen, was schon getan ist, wann das nächste Update kommt, und beim Kundenkontakt fragen statt eigenmächtig handeln.

cases.situation: In standup this morning our lead Anna said Leo's deploy broke staging yesterday. It was actually my config change at 4:10pm; Leo deployed right after me and it surfaced then, and I reverted my change at 9:20 today, since when staging has been green. Leo looked embarrassed and didn't say anything, and I want to message Anna now.
cases.reply: Anna, a correction to this morning: staging broke yesterday because of my config change at 4:10pm, not Leo's deploy. His went out right after mine, which is why it looked like his. I reverted my change at 9:20 today and staging has been green since. I'm sorry, and I'm sorry Leo took the heat for it in standup. I'd like to say this in the team channel too so the record is straight, unless you'd rather do it. From now on I'll post in #deploys before any config change to staging.
cases.note: When someone else was blamed for your mistake, correcting the record the same day, publicly and to them, is part of the fix.

cases.situation: I'm the office coordinator at a physiotherapy clinic. At 10:15 I picked the wrong contact from autofill and emailed our linen supplier, Crisp Linen, a spreadsheet meant for our billing company: 230 patients' names, phone numbers and appointment dates. I've called their office manager, Dave, who is deleting it and will confirm in writing; now I need to tell the practice manager, Helen.
cases.reply: Helen, I need to flag a mistake: at 10:15 I emailed Crisp Linen a spreadsheet meant for our billing company, with 230 patients' names, phone numbers and appointment dates. I've called their office manager, Dave, and asked him to delete it and confirm in writing; he's doing that now. I'm sorry, I picked the wrong contact from autofill. Because it's patient data, I think we should check today whether our data protection policy means it has to be reported. Can we go through that together before lunch? From now on I'll password-protect any file with patient details before it leaves the clinic.
cases.note: With personal data, part of the fix is checking reporting duties the same day; don't decide on your own that it's harmless.

cases.situation: I'm Ms Harper and I teach Year 9 maths. The algebra test grades I posted to the parent portal last Friday were wrong: my answer key for question 7 had an error, so all 28 students lost 4 marks they'd earned. I've corrected the grades on the portal and explained it to the class this morning; three parents have already emailed, and I want to message all the parents.
cases.reply: Dear parents, I made a marking error on last Friday's algebra test: my answer key for question 7 was wrong, so every student lost 4 marks they had earned. I've corrected all 28 papers, and the updated grades are on the portal now; every score has gone up by 4. I explained the mistake to the class this morning as well. I'm sorry for the confusion, especially if you'd already talked the result through at home. From now on I'll work through every answer key myself before I mark a test. Ms Harper
cases.note: To a whole group of parents: one message to everyone, the fix already live, and no need for them to chase you individually.

cases.situation: 上周交的差旅报销里，我不小心把一张私人聚餐的发票（426元）也夹进去了，今天发现时报销款已经打到我卡上。想跟财务李姐说清楚。
cases.reply: 李姐，跟您说一个我的失误：上周提交的差旅报销里混进了一张我私人聚餐的发票，金额426元，报销款已经到账了。我今天核对时发现的，这426元我今天就退回公司，麻烦告诉我走哪个流程、转到哪个账户。以后提交前我会把私人票据单独放开，逐张核对后再交。对不起，给您添麻烦了。
cases.note: 涉及钱的错误，主动说、马上退，不解释为什么会混进去；一条具体的防范措施就够了。

cases.situation: Yesterday I told my manager Owen that I'd sent the Hartley client the wrong version of their contract, that I'd asked their legal contact, Ms Reyes, to disregard it, and that from now on I'd check the version number before anything goes out. This morning she replied that they had already countersigned the wrong version on Tuesday. I need to update Owen on Slack.
cases.reply: Owen, update on the Hartley contract: Ms Reyes replied this morning that they countersigned the wrong version on Tuesday, so asking them to disregard it hasn't worked. I've asked her for a call today to agree how we replace it, and I'll have the two versions compared clause by clause for you by noon so we know exactly what differs. I'll message you straight after the call. The version check I set up yesterday stays in place for everything else that goes out.
cases.note: A follow-up when the first fix fails: no second apology, just the new facts, the next step with a time, and the prevention still standing.

cases.situation: I'm an account manager in London. This morning I missed a 9am call with our client Hiroshi Tanaka in Tokyo because I'd put it in my calendar as 9am London time; he waited 15 minutes. The call was to agree the Q4 delivery schedule, and I've since set my calendar to show both time zones.
cases.reply: Dear Mr Tanaka, I missed our 9am call this morning, and that was my mistake: I entered it in my calendar in London time instead of Tokyo time. I'm sorry you waited 15 minutes for me. I'd still like to agree the Q4 delivery schedule this week, so could we speak at 9am Tokyo time on Thursday 1 October or Friday 2 October? I've set my calendar to show both time zones so this doesn't happen again.
cases.note: To a client, own it in one line, then put the effort into making the reschedule easy.

cases.situation: I changed our nightly sales sync on Monday evening. Today my colleague Ines noticed Tuesday's dashboard total is about 3% below the till system; my change seems to be dropping rows, but I don't know why yet. I've already rolled the sync back to last week's version, so tonight's run should be clean. Need to tell my manager Kofi on Slack.
cases.reply: Kofi, heads up: the change I made to the nightly sales sync on Monday evening is dropping rows. Ines spotted that Tuesday's dashboard total is about 3% below the till system. I've rolled the sync back to last week's version, so tonight's run should be clean. I don't know the cause yet; I'm comparing Tuesday's rows against the till export first to see which sales are missing, and I'll update you by 3pm today. Sorry, this one's mine. Once I've found it, I'll add a nightly check that flags any gap between the two totals.
cases.note: Report before you have the root cause: what's contained, what you're checking first, and when the next update comes.

cases.situation: I'm an account executive. On last Thursday's sales call I told Oakridge Dental that our payroll integration was live, but it's only on the roadmap for Q1. They signed a 40-seat annual contract on Monday, and their ops lead, Hannah, asked this morning when she can switch it on. I need to tell my manager, Chris, on Slack before I answer her.
cases.reply: Chris, I need to flag a mistake: on last Thursday's call I told Oakridge Dental our payroll integration was live, and it's only on the Q1 roadmap. They signed the 40-seat annual contract on Monday, and Hannah, their ops lead, asked this morning when she can switch it on. I haven't replied to her yet. I'd like to tell her the truth today, with the Q1 timeline and what we can offer until then; can we agree the message by 2pm? Sorry, this one's mine. From now on I'll check the live features page before I promise anything on a call.
cases.note: Tell your manager before the customer, and don't paper over the gap in your reply to Hannah; what Oakridge is owed is a joint decision.

cases.situation: 我是装修公司的项目经理。业主刘女士卫生间的墙砖定的是浅灰哑光，我下单时选成了浅灰亮光，工人昨天已经铺完一面墙，她还没去现场看。公司同意拆掉重铺，费用我们出；正确的砖周五（10月2日）到货，整体完工要从10月9日推到10月13日。
cases.reply: 刘女士，跟您说一个我的失误：卫生间墙砖您定的是浅灰哑光，我下单时选成了浅灰亮光，昨天工人已经铺完一面墙。这面墙我们拆掉重铺，费用全部由公司承担。正确的哑光砖周五（10月2日）到货，整体完工时间从10月9日推到10月13日。对不起，是我没核对清楚。以后每次下单前，我都会把型号发给您确认后再下。
cases.note: 向业主认错：错在哪、怎么补救、谁承担费用、新的完工日期一次说清，不推给供应商或工人。

cases.situation: Llevo dos semanas como auxiliar administrativa en una clínica dental. Ayer confirmé por WhatsApp las 14 citas de hoy con el horario de la semana pasada, y esta mañana tres pacientes han llegado cuando la doctora Ruiz no estaba. Ya he llamado a los otros 11 con la hora correcta y he recolocado a los tres el jueves 8 de octubre; quiero decírselo a mi jefa, Lucía.
cases.reply: Lucía, tengo que contarte un error mío: ayer confirmé por WhatsApp las 14 citas de hoy con el horario de la semana pasada, y esta mañana tres pacientes han llegado cuando la doctora Ruiz no estaba. Ya he llamado a los otros 11 con la hora correcta y he recolocado a los tres el jueves 8 de octubre. Lo siento. A partir de ahora comparo las confirmaciones con la agenda del día antes de enviarlas. Si hay algo del proceso de confirmación que debería hacer de otra forma, ¿me lo explicas?
cases.note: Siendo nueva, no compenses de más: el mismo formato que cualquiera, una sola disculpa, y pide que te expliquen el proceso en vez de justificarte.

cases.situation: 我和同事小李一起做给客户的月度报告，我负责的销售数据那页用成了8月的数据，报告昨天已经发给客户周经理。小李负责的部分没问题。我已经把9月的正确数据更新好了，要跟组长陈姐说。
cases.reply: 陈姐，报告一个我的失误：昨天发给周经理的月度报告里，销售数据那页我用成了8月的数据，这页是我负责的，小李那部分没问题。9月的正确数据已经更新好，更正版和给周经理的说明邮件我10分钟内发您过目，您确认后今天就发出。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后报告发出前，我会逐页核对数据的月份和来源。
cases.note: 合作的成果出了错，只认自己那部分，说清楚同事没问题，但不借此撇清，也不把锅推给流程。

cases.situation: I'm the closing shift manager at a café. On Tuesday night I didn't shut the walk-in fridge door properly; the morning team found it at 6am reading 12°C, and following our food safety log they binned about $640 of dairy and prepped food. I've ordered replacements, arriving by 11am, and we're running a short menu until then. I need to text the owner, Marta.
cases.reply: Marta, I need to flag a mistake: I didn't shut the walk-in door properly when I closed on Tuesday, and the morning team found it at 12°C at 6am. Following the food safety log, they binned about $640 of dairy and prepped food. I've ordered replacements, which arrive by 11am, and we're on a short menu until then. I'm sorry, that one's mine. From tonight I'll add a photo of the closed door and the thermometer to the closing checklist before I lock up.
cases.note: With food safety, the binning already followed the log; say so plainly and don't suggest anything could have been saved.

cases.situation: I'm a team lead. At 6:30 this morning we published release notes that used Halden Bank as a named customer example, which their contract doesn't allow. My report Nina wrote them, but I approved the draft without catching it. I took the page down at 9:40 and need to tell my director, Victor, on Slack.
cases.reply: Victor, I approved release notes this morning that named Halden Bank as a customer example, which their contract doesn't allow. The page was live from 6:30 to 9:40, when I took it down. I'm checking with legal by 2pm today whether we need to tell Halden, and I'll draft that note if so. From this week, any customer name in public copy gets checked against the approved reference list before it goes out. The sign-off was mine, so this one is on me.
cases.note: When your team's work goes wrong, the approver owns it upward; don't name the person who drafted it.

cases.situation: I'm an in-house recruiter. This morning I sent our standard rejection email to Maya Torres, who is actually our top candidate for the senior designer role; the hiring manager, Felix, wants to talk to her about next steps this week. I picked the wrong name from the candidate list, and I've already told Felix. I'm calling Maya now and need the email to send if she doesn't pick up.
cases.reply: Hi Maya, I tried to call because you deserve to hear this directly: the rejection email I sent you this morning was my mistake. I picked the wrong name from our candidate list, and it was not meant for you. You are still very much in the process for the senior designer role, and Felix would like to talk to you about next steps this week. I'm sorry for the shock that email must have given you. From today, every rejection gets a second check against the shortlist before it goes out. Could we speak today or tomorrow, at whatever time suits you?
cases.note: To an external candidate: correct it the same morning, call first, and don't promise an offer before it's formally approved.

cases.situation: 我是行政，负责订会议室。上周给我们部门10月8日（周四）下午的培训订会议室时，我把市场部当天下午见客户的大会议室预订覆盖掉了，今天他们的同事小王来确认时才发现。我已经把培训挪到小会议室，大会议室给市场部重新订好了，截图也发给了小王。要跟市场部负责人周姐说一声。
cases.reply: 周姐，跟您说一个我的失误：上周给我们部门订培训会议室时，我把你们10月8日（周四）下午见客户的大会议室预订覆盖掉了，今天小王来确认时才发现。现在大会议室已经给你们重新订好，截图发给小王了，我们的培训挪到了小会议室，你们见客户的安排不受影响。对不起，差点耽误你们的正事。以后系统提示会覆盖已有预订时，我会先看清是谁的，再联系对方，不会直接点确认。
cases.note: 对平级部门认错：第一句说清错在哪，紧接着说已经恢复，让对方马上放心，再给一条具体的防范。

cases.situation: I manage a small bookshop with a team of four. Last month I approved both Tom's and Lucy's leave for 19 to 23 October without noticing they overlap, which leaves us one short of the three people we need on the floor. I'm not cancelling either; I'll work the shop floor myself that week. I want to post in our team WhatsApp.
cases.reply: Quick one, and it's my mistake: I approved both Tom's and Lucy's leave for 19 to 23 October without spotting the overlap, which leaves us one short on the floor that week. Both bookings stand, so nobody needs to change their plans. I'll cover the gap by working the floor myself all week, and the updated rota will be up by Friday 9 October. From now on I'll check every leave request against the shared calendar before I approve it.
cases.note: Owning a mistake to your own team: the fix shouldn't cost the people who did nothing wrong.

cases.situation: 我负责公司的官方微博。今天上午10:05，我本想用个人号吐槽一部电视剧，结果发到了公司官方账号上，10:30同事提醒我才删掉，删之前大约有120条转发，我已经截图保存。要马上在企业微信上跟市场部赵总说。
cases.reply: 赵总，报告一个我的失误：今天上午10:05，我把一条本想发在个人号上的电视剧吐槽，误发到了公司官方微博，10:30已经删除，删除前大约有120条转发。截图我已经保存，11点前整理好发您；如果需要发一条说明，我先拟好稿子给您定。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后这台手机只登录官方账号，个人号我换另一台设备用。
cases.note: 账号误发：先说发了什么、挂了多久、多少人看到，再说已经做了什么；要不要公开说明由领导定，自己先把稿子备好。

cases.situation: 我是公司的配送司机。今天下午3点在仓库倒车时，我没下车看也没请人指挥，把尾号27的货车右后角撞到了装卸台的柱子上，尾灯碎了，后门有一道凹痕；没人受伤，货也没事，照片我已经拍了。尾灯不亮我就没再开上路，今天剩下的四单请同事老李用他的车帮忙送了，要跟车队主管孙姐说。
cases.reply: 孙姐，报告一个我的失误：今天下午3点我在仓库倒车，把尾号27的货车右后角撞到了装卸台的柱子上，尾灯碎了，后门有一道凹痕。没有人受伤，车上的货也没事。照片已经拍好，马上发您；尾灯不亮，这辆车我先不开上路了，今天剩下的四单已经请老李用他的车帮忙送。对不起，是我倒车时没下车看，也没请人指挥。以后在装卸区倒车，我都先下车看一圈或者请人在后面指挥。维修和保险要走什么流程，您告诉我，我今天就去办。
cases.note: 车辆事故先说有没有人受伤，再说车况和已经做的安排；维修和保险按公司流程走，问清楚再办。

cases.situation: I'm the office manager at a dental practice. In March I handled the renewal of our cleaning contract with Sparrow Cleaning and missed that it auto-renewed at a rate $180 a month higher, so we've overpaid $1,080 since April; I found it today. I've emailed them asking to go back to the old rate and they'll reply by Friday 9 October, and I've set a reminder 60 days before every contract renewal. I need to tell the practice owner, Dr Lin.
cases.reply: Dr Lin, I need to flag a mistake I made in March. When I renewed our contract with Sparrow Cleaning, I missed that it auto-renewed at $180 a month more, so we've paid $1,080 extra since April. I found it today and have already emailed them asking to go back to the old rate; they'll reply by Friday 9 October. I'm sorry, I should have checked the renewal terms. I've now set a reminder 60 days before every contract renewal so this can't slip through again.
cases.note: A mistake found months later still gets reported the day you find it, with the total, not just the monthly figure.
